node.title: Rate-half MCA global-core rank/support/distance router
node.closure: exact composition of three complementary global-core payments
node.statement: After one whole-line global-core cancellation, gauge the shortened direction by a minimum lift of support e=R-j and let r be the transformed explanation affine rank. The rank envelope, exact common-zero support envelope, and recursive direction-distance envelope apply to the same selected slope family. Through shortened dimension 4992 on KoalaBear, ranks at most 13 are paid, ranks 14,15,16,17 are additionally paid for e at most 31768,1576,94,5, and every rank is paid for e at least R-J_rec(s). Through dimension 4979 on Mersenne-31, ranks at most 5 are paid, ranks 6,7,8,9 are additionally paid for e at most 11847,646,36,2, and every rank is paid for e at least R-J_rec(s). Exact first-residual open intervals are pinned in the certificate.
